howto.name: Upload the PDF
howto.text: Drop a PDF up to 500 MB. Best for scanned documents with consistent margins.

howto.name: Let auto-detection scan
howto.text: PrivaTools analyses the bounding box of actual content on each page using PyMuPDF — ignoring whitespace, page numbers in margins, and scan-edge artifacts.

howto.name: Download the cropped PDF
howto.text: Click Auto Crop. Each page's MediaBox is shrunk to the detected content bounding box, eliminating dead margins.

faq.q: Will this make text run off the page?
faq.a: No — the algorithm leaves a small safety margin around detected content. If a page has no content (blank), the original MediaBox is kept.

faq.q: What if my PDF has different page sizes after scanning?
faq.a: Auto-crop computes the bounding box per-page, so pages are independently cropped to their own content.
After auto-crop, printing produces a smaller paper size. If you need the same paper size with less margin, use the Resize tool afterwards.
